title: Bundle
description: A bundle is a named list of packs delivered as one download, in `danbyte/bundles/<id>/bundle.yaml`. It has no entries of its own. `danbyte-lib build-pack` turns it into one zip holding each included pack as a complete pack folder; Danbyte installs the packs in it one by one and records each as its own pack. A bundle must include every pack its packs require.

id.description: The bundle's id, the same as its folder. Never the id of a pack.

name.description: The name shown for the download.

description.description: One sentence on what the bundle holds.

version.description: Leave out to take the highest version among its packs.

includes.description: The packs in the bundle, by id, in the order Danbyte installs them: a pack after the ones it requires.
